options.en: a talent you are born with
a test at the end of the year

why.en: A habit is an action you repeat, for example every day.
why.uz: Habit: odat, yaʼni muntazam, masalan har kuni takrorlanadigan ish.
why.ru: Habit: привычка, то есть действие, которое повторяют регулярно, например каждый день.

stem.en: According to the text, what does a mistake show you?

why.en: The text says that each mistake "shows you what to practise next".
why.uz: Matnda har bir xato "shows you what to practise next" deyilgan: endi nimani mashq qilishni koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: В тексте сказано, что каждая ошибка "shows you what to practise next": показывает, что тренировать дальше.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Her marks are much higher this term. The teacher is pleased with her ___."

why.en: Higher marks mean she is getting better, and getting better is progress.
why.uz: Baholar oshgan, yaʼni u oldinga siljigan. Progress: oʻsish.
why.ru: Оценки стали выше, значит, она продвинулась. Progress: прогресс.

options.en: something that helps you or is better
a machine such as a phone
a rule that you must follow

why.en: An advantage is a good side of something: it makes things easier or better.
why.uz: Advantage: afzallik, yaʼni biror narsaning ishni osonlashtiradigan yaxshi tomoni.
why.ru: Advantage: преимущество, то есть хорошая сторона, которая делает что-то легче или лучше.

stem.en: According to the text, who does online study work best for?

options.en: students who can plan their own time
students who live in the capital
students who like games and videos

why.en: The last sentence says it "works best for students who can plan their own time".
why.uz: Oxirgi gapda shunday deyilgan: "works best for students who can plan their own time".
why.ru: В последнем предложении сказано: "works best for students who can plan their own time".

stem.en: Choose the word: "Please be quiet. Loud music will ___ the people who are reading."

why.en: Loud music takes readers' attention away: it distracts them.
why.uz: Baland musiqa oʻqiyotganlarning diqqatini boʻladi. Distract: chalgʻitmoq.
why.ru: Громкая музыка мешает сосредоточиться на чтении. Distract: отвлекать.

options.en: a regular trip to work or school
a line of cars that cannot move
dirty air in a big city
a ticket for the bus or the metro

why.en: Your commute is the trip you make regularly to school or to work.
why.uz: Commute: har kuni ishga yoki oʻqishga boradigan yoʻl.
why.ru: Commute: регулярная поездка на работу или учёбу.

stem.en: According to the text, how do many cities try to reduce the problem?

options.en: by closing schools in the morning

why.en: The text says: "Many cities try to reduce the problem by improving public transport."
why.uz: Matnda shunday yozilgan: "Many cities try to reduce the problem by improving public transport."
why.ru: В тексте написано: "Many cities try to reduce the problem by improving public transport."

stem.en: Choose the word: "Factories near the river are a serious cause of water ___."

why.en: Factories make water dirty, and dirty water is water pollution.
why.uz: Zavodlar suvni iflos qiladi. Pollution: ifloslanish.

options.en: not enough of something that is needed
a place where water is kept
a small hole in a pipe

why.en: In a shortage there is less of something than people need.
why.uz: Shortage: tanqislik, yaʼni kerakli narsa yetarli emas.
why.ru: Shortage: нехватка, то есть нужного меньше, чем требуется.

stem.en: According to the text, what uses the largest share of water?

why.en: The text says: "Farms consume the largest share."
why.uz: Matnda shunday yozilgan: "Farms consume the largest share."
why.ru: В тексте написано: "Farms consume the largest share."

stem.en: Choose the word: "National parks were created to ___ rare animals and plants."

why.en: A national park keeps rare animals and plants safe: it protects them.
why.uz: Milliy bogʻ noyob hayvon va oʻsimliklarni asraydi. Protect: asramoq.
why.ru: Национальный парк бережёт редких животных и растения. Protect: защищать.

options.en: the place you are travelling to
the bags you take on a trip
a ticket you buy in advance
the time when a train leaves

why.en: Your destination is where your trip ends: the place you want to reach.
why.uz: Destination: boriladigan manzil, yaʼni safar tugaydigan joy.
why.ru: Destination: пункт назначения, то есть место, где заканчивается поездка.

stem.en: According to the text, why is it wise to book a ticket early?

why.en: The text says: "because seats sell out before holidays."
why.uz: Matnda shunday yozilgan: "because seats sell out before holidays."
why.ru: В тексте написано: "because seats sell out before holidays."

stem.en: Choose the word: "The bus arrived forty minutes late, and the driver apologised for the ___."

why.en: Arriving later than planned is a delay, and that is what a driver says sorry for.
why.uz: Rejadan kech kelish kechikish deyiladi. Delay: kechikish.
why.ru: Прибытие позже, чем планировалось, называется задержкой. Delay: задержка.

options.en: to become well or strong again

why.en: To recover is to return to a normal, healthy state after tiredness or illness.
why.uz: Recover: tiklanmoq, yaʼni charchoq yoki kasallikdan keyin kuchga qaytmoq.
why.ru: Recover: восстанавливаться, то есть возвращать силы после усталости или болезни.

stem.en: According to the text, what happens during sleep?

why.en: The text says: "the body and the brain recover from the day, and new knowledge is stored."
why.uz: Matnda shunday yozilgan: "the body and the brain recover from the day, and new knowledge is stored."
why.ru: В тексте написано: "the body and the brain recover from the day, and new knowledge is stored."

stem.en: Choose the word: "Turn off the TV, please. I cannot ___ on my homework."

why.en: With the TV on you cannot give all your attention to homework: you cannot concentrate.
why.uz: Televizor yoqilgan boʻlsa, diqqatni vazifaga jamlab boʻlmaydi. Concentrate: diqqatni jamlamoq.
why.ru: При включённом телевизоре трудно сосредоточиться на уроках. Concentrate: сосредоточиться.
